event_name: Date 11 September 2021 Time 17:26 2021 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 September 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 11 left the track in turn 2 and was alleged to have gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The stewards reviewed video and radio evidence. Car 11 was attempting to overtake Car 18 at Turn 1 / 2. He cut behind the kerb and rejoined the track in front of Car 18 gaining an advantage. In accordance with Art. 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Race Director gave the opportunity to give back the whole of the advantage he gained. The Stewards observed that the team then gave this instruction to the driver (Perez) who complied with this within a reasonable time, giving the position back to Car 18. The Stewards were satisfied that he gave back the whole of any advantage he gained. The Stewards therefore take no further action.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 11 Alleged Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
